import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import os

# Suppress warnings and progress bars
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Define target and features
target_col = "Cover_Type"
id_col = "Id"
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in [id_col, target_col]]

X = train_df[feature_cols]
y = train_df[target_col]
X_test = test_df[feature_cols]
test_ids = test_df[id_col]

# Split data into training and validation sets (Stratified)
print("Splitting data...")
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Initialize LightGBM Classifier
# Using parameters suitable for large tabular data
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=1000,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=63,
    max_depth=-1,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
)

# Train the model
print("Training model...")
model.fit(
    X_train,
    y_train,
    eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
)

# Evaluate on validation set
print("Evaluating model...")
val_predictions = model.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_predictions)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Predict on test set
print("Predicting on test set...")
test_predictions = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Save submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": test_predictions})
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
